safetyBoundary.en: Use only while seated and when the crew permits it. Stop for safety briefings, instructions, turbulence or whenever the adult says to pause.
safetyBoundary.zh-Hant: 只有在坐好且機組人員允許時才使用。安全說明、任何指示、亂流，或大人要求暫停時，立即停止活動。

text.en: one shape outside the window, if your seat has a view
text.zh-Hant: 座位看得到窗外時，窗外的一種形狀

text.en: two different materials near your seat
text.zh-Hant: 座位附近兩種不同材質

text.en: one item the crew uses to share information
text.zh-Hant: 一件機組人員用來傳達資訊的物品
看得到天空時，一朵雲的形狀

text.en: one polite way to help your row
text.zh-Hant: 一種可協助同排乘客的禮貌做法

promptTemplate.en: From your current spot, notice {target}. Point only when the setting permits and your supervising adult has said it is safe; never ask a driver to look.
promptTemplate.zh-Hant: 從目前位置觀察「{target}」。只有在情境允許且陪同大人已確認安全時，才從原地指出來；絕不要求駕駛查看。

promptTemplate.en: Notice {target}. Think of one colour, shape, sound or detail. Share only with a non-driving companion when the setting permits.
promptTemplate.zh-Hant: 觀察「{target}」，想一個顏色、形狀、聲音或細節；只有在情境允許且有非駕駛同行者時才分享。

promptTemplate.en: Use {target} as a prompt. Invent one kind question, route idea or tiny story alone or with a non-driving companion when permitted.
promptTemplate.zh-Hant: 以「{target}」為提示，自己想一個友善問題、小路線或迷你故事；情境允許時也可和非駕駛同行者一起想。
